(collectivement, « Osisko Développement »).

headlines.title: South Plains Financial, Inc. Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
headlines.summary: LUBBOCK, Texas, July 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- South Plains Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ:SPFI) (“South Plains” or the “Company”), the parent company of City Bank, today announced that its second quarter 2026 financial results will be released before the market opens on Friday, July 17, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET on the same day to discuss its financial results.
